column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.101.
# THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE. CM051 VENDORS IT.
# CM051 scripts/sync_cut_bom.sh copies this file into cuts/v1.0.101/ there and
# records the OS003 commit it came from in cuts/BOM_PIN.
# (v1.0.100's copy of this line still said v1.0.99, carried forward unedited.
# Corrected here rather than carried a third time.)
# WHY THIS CUT EXISTS
# v1.0.100 WAS built and WAS walked, and the walk failed six probes, every one
# of which can only run against an installed Ostler. Four of the six were
# introduced between v1.0.95 and v1.0.100. This cut carries the remediations
# for those, plus the consumer-side sweep that ran off the back of them.
# HOW THE ROWS BELOW WERE CHOSEN, AND WHAT THE METHOD CANNOT SEE
# NOT carried forward from v1.0.100. That carry-forward was correct exactly
# once, for v1.0.100, because v1.0.99 shipped NOTHING: it was tagged, both apps
# were signed, Apple accepted the notarisation, and it died at staple-apps, so
# no artefact ever existed and its BOM was still owed. v1.0.100 did ship and
# was walked, so its rows are already in an artefact and repeating them here
# would assert this cut must contain work it does not introduce.
# The rows are every pull request merged to CM051 main after the v1.0.100 BOM
# was written (2026-09-17T14:56:45+08:00) that changed AT LEAST ONE FILE THAT
# SHIPS. "Ships" is measured, not judged: the change touches a path outside
# tests/, scripts/, .github/, cut-manifests/, cuts/, docs/, walks/, launch/ and
# gui/OstlerInstallerTests/. 81 pull requests merged in that window and 34
# touched a shipping file. CONTROL on the predicate, because a filter that
# answered the same for everything would be useless: #2143 fix(install) scores
# 1 shipping file and #2146 board: scores 0, so it separates the two kinds.
# WHAT THE METHOD CANNOT SEE, stated rather than left for someone to discover:
# a pull request that changes no shipping file can still change what a customer
# gets, by re-pinning something fetched at build time. The 47 excluded are
# board, gate, docs and test work, and none of them was read individually.
# EVERY capability_id IS `none`, ON PURPOSE, AND THAT IS NOT AN OVERSIGHT
# `none` means UNGUARDED: gates/capability_matrix.sh proves nothing about these
# rows, and any of them can silently regress. That is a real and recorded gap,
# and it is the outstanding half of this BOM.
# It is still the correct value today, because the alternative is worse. A
# capability_id names a PATTERN that proves the change is present in a signed
# artefact. An id that does not correspond to the change reads as GUARDED to
# everything downstream while checking something unrelated, which is the exact
# failure this repo keeps paying for: a gate whose denominator excludes its own
# subject.
# MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. A keyword matcher was run over all 177 manifest ids to
# see whether the mapping could be derived rather than authored. It claimed 27
# of 34 and it was wrong: it mapped "a dropped Notion or Obsidian export is
# findable" to doctor_status_poll_has_a_fork_budget, "a forget that found
# nobody told the customer it had erased them" to
# hub_wiki_iframe_does_not_crop_nav, and "nine customer strings called it the
# iOS Companion" to declined_recording_consent_removes_the_capture_agent. One
# of the 27 was right. Those ids were discarded rather than written down.
# So: 34 rows recording WHAT WAS BUILT, so that nothing ships by being
# remembered, and 34 capability rows still owed in
# manifest/capability_manifest.tsv. Count the rows; no number is written in
# prose here, for the reason v1.0.100's header already gives.
# The refs are the SHA of the squash commit on CM051 main, not any branch tip,
# because a branch tip is not what ships.
what

fix(install): two interval agents tick against programs being rewritten under them

vendor: regenerate the five patches that applied cleanly and did not reconstruct

board: the five vendored trees still divergent, each with the exact blocker measured (row 2207)
vendor: three load-bearing vendor-only files were protected by nothing
vendor: record six divergences the register had fallen behind or denied, no shipped bytes changed
vendor(cm041): re-pin identity_resolver to 9e260949, content and pin together (row 2202 gate 2)

fix(compose): mount the AI Conversations tree, third instance of one shape (#979)

fix(wiki): the summary backfill was invisible to the lock it was waiting for (#2112)
fix(install): every detected export reaches the importer, and a decline still means no (#957)
fix(copy): nine customer strings called it the iOS Companion, and nothing was checking
fix(doctor): the customer's own status page was showing them the year 2318
fix(privacy): a forget that found nobody told the customer it had erased them
fix(people): the two stores disagreed about how many people you know, and nothing repaired it
fix(applications): one Ostler folder, and the consent text stops naming an app that does not exist
fix(egress): the address carried unexplained for three weeks, explained and declared
repin(wiki): the images carrying the lint fix, verified by label not by report
fix(signals): the payloads never said what they were, so the whole band was dropped
fix(preferences): the projector shipped and nothing called it
